entries.complaint: Tanks have no fuel gauge, so the grill runs out mid-cook; add-on gauges are unreliable or restrict gas flow
entries.redesign: A tank collar or grill foot with a built-in scale that shows the fuel left in hours of cooking, plus a warning when roughly one cook remains

entries.complaint: Lightweight expandable hoses burst, split or leak at the connector within a season, and buyers return two or three in a row
entries.redesign: A reinforced strain-relief sleeve where the hose meets each fitting, and connectors that unscrew so a failed end can be replaced without throwing out the hose

entries.complaint: Overpriced proprietary spools jam or weld the line to itself, so the head has to be opened and rewound mid-job
entries.redesign: A load-through head that takes cut lengths of standard line, with no spool to wind and no proprietary refills

entries.complaint: After winter storage the mower won't start, because ethanol fuel left in the carburetor goes stale and gums it up
entries.redesign: A fuel shutoff that runs the carburetor dry when the engine stops, plus a sealed tank that drains to a cap for storage
entries.prior_art: Fuel shutoff valves; run-dry storage routines

entries.complaint: Cushions fade within weeks to a year and grow mildew when left out, so they have to be carried inside after every rain
entries.redesign: Solution-dyed fabric over open-cell drain-through foam with a mesh bottom panel, so cushions dry in place instead of holding water
entries.prior_art: Solution-dyed acrylic covers; quick-dry reticulated foam
